sources.quote: We introduce DENIAL PROMPTING which pushes LLMs to develop more creative solutions to a given problem by incrementally imposing new constraints on the previous solution, compelling LLMs to adopt new s...
sources.why: Closest prior work: it bans techniques in code generation and scores creativity, but it does not set a lexical (name-based) compliance reading against an exact behavioural reading of the same program,...

sources.quote: real-world applications often demand stricter adherence to detailed requirements such as coding style, line count, and structural constraints, beyond mere correctness.
sources.why: Checks instruction constraints in code with programmatic checks, but on style and structure constraints, not on prohibitions of a named algorithm read through behaviour.

sources.id: arXiv:2510.27353 (Herrmann and Pallez, An In-depth Study of LLM Contributions to the Bin Packing Problem)
sources.quote: we reassess this claim through a detailed analysis of the heuristics produced by LLMs, examining both their behavior and interpretability.
sources.quote_2: The derived algorithms are significantly simpler, more efficient, more interpretable, and more generalizable, suggesting that the considered instances are themselves relatively simple.
sources.why: Behavioural analysis of LLM-evolved bin-packing heuristics; supplies the ab family used here as the 'simple baseline' corpus. No prohibition or compliance study.
